faer-all-tests: nix develop .#stable --command cargo test --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p alea-core -p alea-math -p alea-mcmc --features alea-mcmc/faer
nightly-tests: nix develop .#default --command cargo test --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p alea-math -p alea-mcmc --features alea-mcmc/simd,alea-mcmc/faer --lib --test nuts_allocations --test nuts_contracts --test nuts_sampling --test nuts_warmup --test inverse_metrics
runtime-current-tests: nix develop .#stable --command cargo test --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p alea-runtime --lib --test session --test release_boundaries
miri-owned: nix develop .#default --command sh -c "MIRIFLAGS=-Zmiri-strict-provenance cargo miri test --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p alea-core --test target owned_update_exchanges_storage_only_after_a_complete_success"
clippy: nix develop .#stable --command cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p alea-core -p alea-math -p alea-mcmc --all-targets --features alea-mcmc/faer -- -D warnings
rustdoc: nix develop .#stable --command sh -c "RUSTDOCFLAGS=-Dwarnings cargo doc --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p alea-core -p alea-math -p alea-mcmc -p alea-runtime --features alea-mcmc/faer --no-deps"
